about.title: About
about.content:
Un petit peu... about me

It has been more than 15 years in which my passion and good spirit has been in the animation industry.
From art direction to visual development, I shares my colored artistic eye and crazy ideas in order to find the best solutions 
in the interest of the project. 

Also I had the opportunity to co-found a independant video game studio “Brain Up” with my friend Vincent E. Sousa in 2021. 
We created three prototypes using Unreal, for which I was primarily responsible for art direction and level design.
These projects were well received and received support from the CNC three times.

After four years of investment, I finally decided to go back to being a freelance solo artist, and ready to take on new creative challenges.

I'm currently in France, but I am flexible depending on opportunities.


To get in touch with me :
anton.vivien@gmail.com

salesman-pete.title: Salesman Pete
salesman-pete.content:
Salesman Pete

 2010


Position : 

Author & Background artist


Authors : Marc Bouyer, Max Loubaresse, Anthony Vivien

Pitch :


Pete is a nice and clumsy salesman. But he's also a deadly super secret agent with a microprocessor implanted into his brain by some mad scientists from the government ! He has to secretly stop a bunch of bad guys who stole a magic stone that can change anything into seafood!


Max, Marc and me were driven to create this film entirely on our own, working for a year in an apartment, with the support of our friends and families. Marc did the character design and also animation alongside Max, while I focused on the environments. 
Cyril Marchesseau joined us for the music, we first discovered his work at the time through the short A Kiss from Tokyo by Kevin Dart and Stéphane Coedel.

We went for a 2D/3D hybrid look, which was still rarely used back then. Student films from Gobelins like Burning Safari, Le Building, and California Love were key inspirations for us. Choosing to use 3Ds Max with Scanline turned out to be a huge advantage thanks to its fast rendering, which saved us from long render times.

We’re proud of what we achieved with Salesman Pete, even if the story isn’t particularly well put together!

A selection of my work



                                                   
                                                 

SHORT 
Produced by Max Loubaresse, Marc Bouyer, Anthony Vivien

the-travelling-land.title: The Travelling Land
the-travelling-land.content:
The Travelling Land

 2025
studio : Brain Up
Position : 

Co-Author, Art Director & Level Designer

Time of production : 1 year


Elevator Pitch :


The Travelling Land is a moving-city builder where your floating island sails across the world.  Build your drifting city, raise giant sails to chart new routes, and rescue endangered animal populations as you navigate through extreme, ever-changing ecosystems.


For 10 months, with the support of the CNC, we advanced a highly ambitious project with strong creative and technical foundations. Maxime and Danny delivered meticulous and complex development work, while the Game Design (Vincent) remained at the core of every decision. The project already demonstrates significant strengths and clear potential, but substantial work remains to fully realize its vision.



My work :


Although I oversaw the Art Direction, including the visual design of the buildings and the overall look of the island. 
My role was mainly positioned between Game Design (Vincent) and our two developers, Maxime and Danny. I regularly tested new features as the gameplay loop evolved, and took charge of level design tasks such as placing external resources and designing the discovery of animals in distress, who later become the city’s workers

A Selection of my creations


I worked on designing the prototype level in Miro to establish the tutorial at the beginning of the game, as well as the progression of discovering various items to ensure smooth player progression. Then, I used the tools available to me from the developers to create the game in Unreal.


A selection of screenshots showcasing our project

                                                                     

TEASER - Early Prototype 
Produced by Brain Up

maiko.title: Maiko
maiko.content:
Maiko

 2024
studio : Brain Up
Position : 

Co-Author, Art Director & Level Designer

Time of production : 1 year and a half

Elevator Pitch :


Maiko is a top down action-adventure game. A mix between Death’s Door and Tunic with some Ori’s touch in a nippon themed action-adventure. Katanas, cults and madness are what drives this quest !

For nearly two years, I worked with Vincent ( more involved in game design, 3D supervision, and combat feel) to develop a prototype with financial support from the CNC. Maxime was the first developer to join the team, followed by Danny. And Robin Alonzo, internship on the project. Thank you all team for your hard work.


My work :


I was responsible for creating visual designs related to our lore, as well as providing creative input on the characters designed 
by Alexis Rives.  I worked on designing the prototype level in Miro to establish the tutorial at the beginning of the game, as well as the progression of discovering various items to ensure smooth player progression. Then, I used the tools available to me from the developers to create the level in Unreal.

A Selection of my creations


Level Design :


I worked on designing the prototype level in Miro to establish the tutorial at the beginning of the game, as well as the progression of discovering various items to ensure smooth player progression.


Character Design :


For this project, we were fortunate to have Alexis Rives as our character designer . He did an incredible job, taking our artistic direction into account throughout the process. Here are some of his creations. You can see more of his work here.


Character design : Alexis Rives (Deadslug) 

Team :

Composer: Antoine Cardin
Sound Design: Jules ferry
Chara Animation: Steven Karl Menager

smashescapepickles.title: SmashEscape&Pickles
smashescapepickles.content:
Smash Escape & Pickles

 2020
studio : Brain Up
Position : 

Co-Author, Art Director & Level Designer

Elevator Pitch :


Smash Escape & Pickles was a VR game where you played as a space traveler who crash-lands in a small area of an alien planet. 
The goal was to gather resources and find key items around the map to rebuild your ship and escape a planet that’s about to blow up.
But of course, you’re not the only one trying to get off this planet.

It was the very first project I worked on with my partner at Brain Up, Vincent. He handled most of the Game Design and the Technical Director role (3D modeling, rigging, texturing, animation…) and also did development on Unity.

My work :


I was in charge of creating visual designs tied to our lore, and I also provided creative input on the character designed by Marc Bouyer. 
I handled the first 3D environments for the VR testing phase on the Meta Oculus Quest.

A Selection of my creations
